title: Mimi's Cottage Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutMimi’s Cottage ~ 2615 E. County Hwy 30A ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Break and Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Mimi’s Cottage is an adorable bungalow that is perfect for families, with the perfect Old Seagrove location - just outside Seaside and directly across 30A from the beach! Built in 1953 and still owned by the original family, Mimi’s Cottage holds decades of love and warm memories of multi-generational family beach vacations. Never offered for rentals until now, Mimi’s Cottage has been completely updated, yet continues to retain that nostalgic, old FL beach cottage feel that is becoming more and more rare along 30A these days. With ­­1,906 square feet, Mimi’s Cottage sleeps up to 12 and offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths and parking for 4 cars. On-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly. Main Level: 4 Bedrooms. 3 Full Baths. Fully Equipped Kitchen. Two Dining Tables. Laundry Room. Living Room. Dining Room. Kitchen. #1 Bedroom has 2 sets of bunks (4 Twins), TV. #2 Bedroom has Queen bed (no TV). Hall bath with walk-in shower, shared by Bedrooms #1 and #2 #3 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has King bed, tub/shower, TV. #4 En-Suite Bedroom has 2 Twin beds, tub/shower, TV. Living Room has 2 Twin beds. Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 Smart TVs with YouTube TV Distinctive Features Hickory Street beach access directly across 30A Hardwood floors throughout Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 4 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly) 1 King bed, 1 Queen bed, 4 Twin beds, 2 bunk beds (4 Twins) 3 Full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, hair dryer, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, Whirlpool Stainless appliances, glass top range, French door refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, disposal, coffee maker (drip + Keurig), toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (1/10th mile) WaterColor (7/10th mile) Grayton Beach (2.5 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
